fresh_transfer_rule: At most one new preregistered Boston bounded instance may be constructed and solved after a policy is frozen. No retuning after its first result.

common.initial_multipliers: zero on every dynamic arc; no reference information
common.capacity_subgradient: g[a]=sum_k demand[k]*1[a on priced shortest path(k)]-capacity[a]
common.projected_direction: q[a]=g[a] if lambda[a]>0 or g[a]>0; else 0
common.shortest_path_tie: stable ascending arc ID; first predecessor on ties within 1e-10
common.pool_enrichment: add one complete unique priced shortest path per commodity per iteration; exact arc-ID sequence identity; cap 100 paths per commodity
common.recovery_schedule: independent restricted-path LP at iteration 1, every 10 iterations, and terminal iteration; direct priced paths may provide a feasible candidate when capacity passes
common.plateau_rule: at t>=200 every 50 iterations, stop if best_dual[t]-best_dual[t-99] <= max(1e-7,1e-5*max(0,U-best_dual[t]))
common.stop: first certified 1% algorithm gap, plateau, per-case wall limit, or iteration limit; final independent evaluator decides gate

variants.step_formula: same alpha as R3_CONTINUATION using q
variants.multiplier_update: trial=project(lambda+alpha*g); if current dual improves prior best by >1e-9*max(1,abs(prior best)), next=trial; else next=project(0.8*trial+0.2*best_lambda)

variants.step_formula: d_t=0.7*q_t+0.3*d_(t-1), d_0=0; alpha=min(0.7*(U-D)/max(||d_t||_2^2,1),15/max(||d_t||_2,1)) when finite U>D; otherwise 5/(sqrt(t)*max(||d_t||_2,1))

mandatory_gates.all_cases: independently valid dual, feasible recovered primal, every evaluator integrity check PASS
mandatory_gates.analytic_C0_C1: known objective and feasibility behavior PASS
mandatory_gates.sioux_200: gap<=1%; primal matches accepted objective; gap<=R2 gap 0.0007455676536519011 + 0.0001
mandatory_gates.sioux_250: gap<=1%; primal matches accepted objective; gap<=R2 gap 0.003176989218152705 + 0.0001
mandatory_gates.boston_10od_development: valid dual, feasible primal, independent gap<=1%
mandatory_gates.clean_room: case-independent CLI, mapping, negative tests, solver-free evaluator

selection_rule: Among candidates passing every mandatory development gate: minimize the maximum independently certified gap across the ten development cases; ties within 1e-9 minimize summed solver wall seconds; then lexicographically smallest variant ID. If none passes, select none and do not run fresh transfer.
reference_leakage_prohibition: No reference primal paths, flows, active arcs, duals, or optimum in solver, path pool, warm starts, recovery, or stopping. Objective-only comparison is a final evaluator verification gate after each run closes; it cannot alter a policy.
